name: 4DMedical Limited
summary: 4DMedical Limited is a medical technology company headquartered in Carlton, Australia, incorporated in 2012 and active in Australia and the United States. It is commercialising XV Technology, a four-dimensional lung imaging system, along with a software-as-a-service delivery model, XV ventilation analysis software, the Permetium preclinical imaging system and the AccuVent 200 small-animal ventilator.
